provenance.client: Clean-room Go LOCO probe; Android 26.8.2 sender; Mac 26.8.0-derived request models
provenance.method: Bounded requests on one selected regular group after inventory and exact three-owned-account roster verification; one native synthetic control; sender unread observations before/after; no request retry, NOTIREAD, CHATONROOM or history commit

sanitization: Live IDs replaced by synthetic order-preserving representatives. Responses are projections: status, relevant field presence, returned log ordering/types/counts and unread counts are preserved; message bodies, IDs, tokens and unrelated fields are removed.

cases.name: old-interval-below-returned-floor-zero-cur
cases.observation: Requested synthetic messages were seeded on 2026-10-10; returned minLogId exceeded the requested maximum. No fixed retention duration is inferred.

cases.name: fresh-window-sync-continuation
cases.observation: The two ordered SYNCMSG pages equal the bulk page's log-ID sequence, with no overlap. isOK remains false on the final page; it is not a standalone more-data/EOF flag.

fresh_sender_unread_observations.scope: One selected group and one fresh synthetic message, with the two receiver emulators stopped; not a general direct/group no-read-effect guarantee
